title: Cross-thread provision hook reentry can deadlock behind verifier lock
description: Fresh final timing robustness review: ProvisionVerifier install/clear call integrity and persistence hooks while holding __lock. The __transitioning guard rejects same-thread RLock reentry, but a hook that starts another thread calling install/clear/current and waits for it deadlocks: the child blocks acquiring __lock while the hook holds the parent transition. Make transition ownership/reentry detection observable before blocking on the verifier state lock (or execute hooks in a transaction design that does not hold a lock needed by callbacks), and fail closed without partial state. Add bounded join tests for install→threaded install, install→current/floor, clear→install, callback exception, and ordinary concurrent callers.
notes: Independent security rereview also reproduced an ABBA variant: ProvisionVerifier holds its lock while invoking persistence hooks, while tracker/floor reads can hold tracker state and wait on the verifier; a hook that touches tracker state completes the cycle. Fix lock ordering/callback execution so no external hook runs while holding a lock required by tracker reads, and cover forced two-thread ABBA with bounded joins.
